text:
[HGN (KDD 2019)](https://arxiv.org/html/1906.09217) applies user-conditioned sigmoid gates first to embedding dimensions, then to individual recent items; average/max pooling produces a short-term representation. Prediction adds long-term user–candidate, pooled short-term–candidate, and summed recent-item–candidate dot products. Its default recent window is already five items. Ablations compare feature/instance gates, average/max pooling, and removing item–item scoring; average pooling generally wins. [SHAN (IJCAI 2018)](https://www.ijcai.org/Proceedings/2018/0546.pdf) instead uses user-conditioned, softmax-normalized attention over historical items, then another attention pool over that long-term vector plus recent item embeddings. Neither mechanism is simply one scalar sigmoid interpolating two complete representations.

Assessment: mixing SASRec context with a normalized recent mean is an incremental architectural combination; long/short fusion, gating, pooling, and five-item windows have clear precedents. Define the distinction precisely: m_t=LayerNorm(masked_mean(e_{t−4:t})); z_t=(1−g_t)h_t+g_t m_t. Specify whether g is globally learned or input-conditioned, and whether embeddings are taken before positional encoding/dropout. SASRec context is history-dependent, not automatically a distinct long-term user representation. LayerNorm normalizes feature statistics; SHAN’s softmax normalizes attention weights. These serve different purposes.

Recommended controls: original SASRec; mean-only; fixed mixture versus learned scalar; scalar versus input-conditioned/vector gate; matched-parameter context-only adapter; windows 1/5/10/full; older-history or randomly selected historical items; mean/max/attention pooling; no normalization versus mean-only/both-branch LayerNorm. For g multiplying the mean branch, compare initial logits 0 (g=0.5) and −4 (g≈0.018); zero gate-network weights make these exact for conditioned gates. These initialization choices are proposed controls, not claims about HGN/SHAN. Construct every training-position pool causally and exclude padding. Keep optimization and evaluation identical; report per-category and macro validation HR@10.
